plan.notes: Source: official NAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog progression plan for 'Psychological Sciences, Bachelor of Science' (plan code PSYCBS), transcribed verbatim from https://catalog.nau.edu/ProgressionPlans/view.jsp?inst=NAU00&cat=2526&type=4YR&plan=PSYCBS&sub= on 2026-09-30 (CDT). Transcription method: automated parse of every term table (course description, units, notes) from the official plan page, spot-checked against the rendered page. Term names follow NAU's own 'Year N Term M: Season' structure. NAU uses 'units'; each unit is a semester unit, treated as a credit. Generic slots (General Studies/Inclusive Perspectives, Foundation English/Math, electives, ME depth/breadth electives) are modeled as choice:true student-choice slots quoting the plan's official wording; 'or'-options are choice slots naming the official alternatives. Per-course prerequisites are NOT listed on NAU progression plans, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty. NAU's own disclaimer: 'Sample Progression Plans are for planning purposes only; see the catalog for official details.' Campus availability per the plan page includes Flagstaff.
